notes.title: Only 24hrs Remain!
notes.content: [p]Hello beautiful people of Steam,[/p][p]It's been a long and wild 30 odd days, but our [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skeletalgames/spill-the-beans"]Kickstarter campaign[/url] ends in just 24 hours![/p][p]If you've been considering pledging to the campaign, now is the time to do so. Whether it's for a copy or the game or throwing the equivalent of a coffee our way to help us get over the finish line, every little is appreciated immensely by our tiny team.[/p][p]We'd also invite you to take a look at our Kickstarter updates, where we've been talking about various things, including a sneak peak into how [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skeletalgames/spill-the-beans/posts/4450730"]accusation is going to work in the full game[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751204/7a78e50df891a3113966e415e77762bbb4f9c53f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Finally, we hope you've been enjoying the new expanded demo! If any of you have found the new bad ending it's brought… you know what you did.[/p][p]Lots of love, the Skeletal Games team.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skeletalgames/spill-the-beans" style="button" buttoncolor="#388c36"]Check out the Kickstarter![/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Demo Update & Kickstarter Live Now!
notes.content:
[p]Our new, improved, updated demo is now live! And alongside it… our Kickstarter! (check it out [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skeletalgames/spill-the-beans"]here[/url])[/p][p]Included in this new demo we have:[/p][list][*][p]Investigation mode! Talk to your scapegoats to find new evidence.[/p][/*][*][p]2 of 15 total routes in the game. Talk to Alexandra and Grudge to start building a case against them![/p][/*][*][p]The Evidence Notebook, AKA the best place to keep an eye on all the evidence gathered and how you've made everyone else feel along the way…[/p][/*][*][p]The Map - choose who to talk to, or who to listen in on.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also just, talk to Dave. If you want.[/p][/*][/list][p]We recommend you start new saves to continue the demo in case of compatibility issues, but liberal use of the skip button located at the bottom of the screen should get you far! We'll be implementing a more comprehensive quick start option for the full game, we promise.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751204/9de796a9e7653365abf172066a45b9d2987278b8.png"][/img][/p][p]As for the Kickstarter, we'd love it if you could check out the page, but for a quick summary, here are some rewards available:[/p][list][*][p]New hairstyle customisation options[/p][/*][*][p]Help shape the game with early beta access[/p][/*][*][p]Become a background character[/p][/*][*][p]Get added to the board of shame as a banned customer[/p][/*][*][p]Soundtrack and artbook digital download[/p][/*][*][p]Share the campaign and its social posts to get a Date with Dave![/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for all the love and wishlists the game has received so far, we're very excited to bring the full game to you. In the meantime, we'll keep you updated on our progress![/p][p]Lots of love, the Skeletal Games team.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Coming Soon: Demo Update & Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[p]Hey there Steam denizens, it's been a little while! [/p][p][/p][p]We've been busy, working quietly in the background to bring you an updated demo showcasing how investigation works in Spill the Beans. That's right, on [b]7th July[/b] you'll be able to interrogate our scapegoats in two of the fifteen total routes that will be available in the full game - and maybe see where the story takes you on the way! [/p][p][/p][p]And on the note of updates, we'll also be launching our [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skeletalgames/spill-the-beans"]Kickstarter [/url]on that day! This game has been a passion project of ours for the last few years, and we hope to use the Kickstarter to let us dedicate proper time to getting the game over the finish line!
[/p][p]Should you back the Kickstarter or help spread awareness, you'll be able to get some fun rewards like new customisation options, an artbook, and even the ability to date one of our NPCs in a special side story (goals willing).
[/p][p]We hope to see you back here on the 7th, for the new demo and Kickstarter! In the meantime, feel free to follow us on our socials.
[/p][p]Lots of love, the Skeletal Games team.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Next Fest Wrap up & Milestone Giveaway
notes.content:
Next Fest is over but fear not, we’re not saying goodbye to our demo. Rather, to thank you all for such fantastic support we’re doing a giveaway!

This celebration marks us reaching 1k followers on our [url=https://x.com/Skeletal_Games]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@skeletal_games]Tiktok[/url] pages, as well as almost 3k wishlists here on steam… Wow, thank you all so much!

If you’d like our artist to draw you or your character with Grimoire icon Alex Argyros (including a selection of filters), simply wishlist the game and comment down below to tell us about your Barista and how they chose to play through the demo. If you’d like more chances of winning, you can also participate on Twitter and Tiktok - each platform gets a winner! Just be sure to enter before the competition closes on the 7th of July.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751204/13eb4ff25df7f196880525e2f872a9337b1165a5.png[/img]

If you'd like to have a go at drawing yourself or your character alongside Alex, you'll find the raw files (including .psd) here! ➡️ https://bit.ly/stb-raffle-files

Please tag us in any creations! We'd love to see what you brew up 💜☕

Aside from the Giveaway, we’ll be updating the demo tomorrow to fix a few small bugs and issues, thank you to everyone who’s reported them to us!
